name: Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company
summary: Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company, a real estate development company, develops residential villas and commercial buildings in Saudi Arabia. It is also involved in contracting residential buildings; purchase and sale of real estate land; division and off-plan sales activities of lands; commercial property leasing; and development of commercial buildings. The company was formerly known as Nasser and Abdulsalam Abdulrahman AlMajed Real Estate Company and changed its name to Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company in 2020. Dar Al Majed Real Estate Company was founded in 2014 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
